🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -3.45% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +4.11% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND confirm risk-on, with HYG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND showing credit stress easing.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit health improving: HYG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.37% | 1M: -1.33%) RECOVERY. Fear falling: VXX (1W: -3.45% | 1M: -1.02%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and Stocks vs Bonds metric (SPY/TLT) ↑ rising (SPY (1W: +4.11% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND; TLT (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.69%) BELOW TREND).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-easing: Dollar Strength (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND, yield-sensitive TLT (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.69%) BELOW TREND signals slightly tighter real yields but overall conditions supportive of risk.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leadership: XLK (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +1.81%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +7.16% | 1M: +0.14%) ABOVE TREND driving performance; Financials XLF (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +4.57%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND confirm cyclicals participation — style: Growth/Momentum leading.

5. US vs Global?
US outperformance: SPY (1W: +4.11% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND; Europe lagging VGK-like (Europe vs US ↓ falling) while China FXI (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +11.76%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +5.84% | 1M: -2.32%) RECOVERY show selective EM strength.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation recovering: ARKK (1W: +5.95% | 1M: -8.19%) RECOVERY, IWM (1W: +2.84% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +0.69% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND indicate risk-on breadth includes smaller caps and crypto ETFs.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Reflation tilt: CPER (1W: +4.72% | 1M: +6.08%) ABOVE TREND and PPLT (1W: +8.25% | 1M: +6.14%) ABOVE TREND show industrial/precious metals strength, while GLD (1W: +1.30% | 1M: -2.09%) RECOVERY is showing profit-taking dynamics.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed-to-strong: XLE (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +13.47%) CORRECTION but 1M strength; natural gas UNG (1W: -0.31% | 1M: -16.57%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +4.11% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND, XLK (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +1.81%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +4.57%) ABOVE TREND show coherent leadership; DIVERGENCE: multiple thematic/industry ETFs (SOXX (1W: +10.33% | 1M: -6.76%) RECOVERY, ARKK (1W: +5.95% | 1M: -8.19%) RECOVERY, TAN (1W: +8.70% | 1M: -7.25%) RECOVERY) exhibit 1W/1M mismatches suggesting short-term chop.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to growth/momentum and cyclicals given XLK (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +1.81%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND, and reduce exposure to duration via TLT (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.69%) BELOW TREND while monitoring thematic volatility.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +1.81%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLU (Utilities) and XLP (Consumer Staples) showing weakness in sector breadth (XLU (1W: -2.67% | 1M: -2.30%) BELOW TREND; XLP (1W: -2.13% | 1M: +2.17%) CORRECTION).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +4.72% | 1M: +6.08%) ABOVE TREND, PPLT (1W: +8.25% | 1M: +6.14%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -0.31% | 1M: -16.57%) BELOW TREND and short-term oil softness in BNO (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +13.47%) CORRECTION.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~21 (complacency threshold), Credit spread/HYG-LQD around 0.75 (credit health), XLK/XLF ratio ~3.23 (tech dominance), SPY (momentum confirm) with SPY (1W: +4.11% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, VXX falling and SPY above trend provide dual confirmation. Tech (XLK) and cyclicals (XLE, XLF) showing relative strength, while thematic ETFs in RECOVERY present a divergence to monitor.
